hook: Your hoverboard dream flew across the English Channel in 2019.
title: He Crossed the Sea on a Jet Board
description:
In 2019, Franky Zapata tried to cross the English Channel on his jet-powered Flyboard Air. His first attempt ended in the water. On the second try he made it to England.

#Shorts #Technology #Hoverboard
